type: ({ agentPresentation, value, onValueChange, onSubmit, context, onRemoveContext, onAttach, onVoice, mentionOptions, onAddContext, onMention, modes, mode, onModeChange, models, model, onModelChange, contextUsage, suggestions, onSuggestion, recent, onOpenRecent, greeting, title, disabled, disabledReason, modeMenuOpen, onModeMenuOpenChange, headingLevel, labels, announcement, appearance, }: TaskStarterProps) => JSX.Element
description:
Start a task (spec section 12.1): a request from the page you are on, with
the right records attached. The host owns the draft, the context and the
mode; the pattern is a prompt entry with chips for the records, an @ picker,
a mode menu that also shows how much of the context is used, suggestions
and recent tasks. The picker is a combobox on the text area, which keeps
focus; an input method's keys never choose, move or send.

parameters.name:
{
  agentPresentation,
  value,
  onValueChange,
  onSubmit,
  context = none,
  onRemoveContext,
  onAttach,
  onVoice,
  mentionOptions,
  onAddContext,
  onMention,
  modes,
  mode,
  onModeChange,
  models,
  model,
  onModelChange,
  contextUsage,
  suggestions,
  onSuggestion,
  recent,
  onOpenRecent,
  greeting,
  title,
  disabled = false,
  disabledReason,
  modeMenuOpen,
  onModeMenuOpenChange,
  headingLevel = 3,
  labels,
  announcement = "polite",
  appearance = "card",
}

agentPresentation.description: Optional identity in the existing task or answer header.

announcement.description: Speak context changes and submission errors, or leave them to the host.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

contextUsage.description: The ring beside the mode, and the usage line in its menu.

disabledReason.description: Why the assistant cannot take a request, as a line under the entry.

greeting.description: The small line above the question.

headingLevel.description: The question's level; the recent list's is one lower. 3 by default.

mentionOptions.description: The records "@" offers, filtered by what follows it.

modeMenuOpen.description: Controls the mode menu; pair `modeMenuOpen` with `onModeMenuOpenChange`.

models.description: Explicit models, as a second radio section of the mode menu.

onAddContext.description: Called with the chosen record's id; the host adds it to `context`.

onMention.description: Used when `mentionOptions` is absent: the host opens its own picker.

onSubmit.description: As the entry beneath: a rejected promise keeps the draft and shows the error.

onSuggestion.description: Called with the chosen suggestion's id; the host fills the draft or sends.

recent.type: readonly { id: string; title: string; status: StatusPillState; time: ReactNode; }[] | undefined

suggestions.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; prompt?: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[] | undefined

title.description: The question; «ماذا نُنجز اليوم؟» by default.
